_readme: Release register for the Kitchen and Garage survey funnels. 'recorded_facts' are statements already verified or confirmed, with their source. They are NOT approvals and never clear the gate. 'items' are what still needs a human decision. The release gate (tests/survey/privacy-approval.js) fails while any item with blocking:true is not status:confirmed with confirmed_by and confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD). Claude Code must never confirm an item on the business's behalf. Each item has a type: 'factual' (a fact only the business can state), 'compliance' (a legal or compliance judgement), or 'technical'. Evidence: docs/SURVEY-PRIVACY-NOTICE-APPROVAL.md. Items marked evidence:'relayed_by_a2b' rest on A2B relaying the client's approval. There is no direct written client approval, signature or client timestamp; confirmed_on is the date A2B relayed it.

Production deployment dpl_Cu1jZy6BPQBawAMqMJwmYcPhTUw6 (main d054aae) is READY on go.wren-builders.online with GHL_SURVEY_KITCHEN_WEBHOOK_URL and GHL_SURVEY_GARAGE_WEBHOOK_URL set as Sensitive, Production-only variables (the Kitchen and Garage v2 receivers). /survey/kitchen-survey, /survey/garage-survey, both thank-you and not-in-area pages, /survey/privacy and all /review/* routes return 200 with noindex. No advert points at them.
recorded_facts.provenance: Vercel variable listing and deployment record, curl and browser checks, 12 Nov 2026. Non-submitting probes only: GET 405, wrong content type 415, empty payload 400, no Origin 403, cross-origin 403, from a /review page 403.
recorded_facts.limits: NO lead was submitted, so end-to-end delivery to the current GHL versions (Kitchen v25, Garage v22) is UNTESTED by A2B. A controlled live test needs separately approved test destinations. Real ad traffic stays NO-GO until it passes.

recorded_facts.statement: On Production: a first visit to every survey page makes zero third-party requests and shows the cookie banner. Reject loads nothing. Accept requests GTM-KF4RWHHQ once and starts Pixel 1135200792433711 with PageView once and no Lead. A direct visit to a thank-you page fires no Lead. Review pages ignore stored consent.
recorded_facts.provenance: Real browser against Production, 12 Nov 2026, with every Google and Meta request intercepted and stubbed so nothing reached Google or Meta. No form was submitted.
recorded_facts.limits: The real Meta Lead after a qualified submission and its receipt in Events Manager are part of the controlled live test, not yet run.

recorded_facts.statement: Controlled Production tests of the outside-Cornwall (No) path PASSED for Kitchen and Garage. Each submission through the real Production website created one GHL contact (Kitchen 5Ir3RB7QhaHAHgBWoYua, Garage vbeBD1qmrU1ASJ0qHTMv) within about 3 seconds, created by the correct v2 workflow (Kitchen 952d05ee…, Garage 0490b32d…), tagged 'dq - outside cornwall' plus the offer and survey-funnel tags, with all answers and attribution stored. No opportunity, no Leads Master row, no conversation or SMS followed, and the browser fired no Meta Lead and no wren_survey_lead (re-checked after several minutes).
recorded_facts.provenance: Live tests, 12 Nov 2026, one submission each, run ids T1112A and T1112B, via Playwright against go.wren-builders.online. GHL read back through the GHL API. Sheet read back through the Sheets API (last data row stayed at 73). Opportunities stayed at 53.
recorded_facts.limits: Records created and left in place: 2 ZZ TEST contacts using fictional Ofcom drama-range numbers (07700 900881, 07700 900882) and @example.com emails. No cleanup done (not authorised). The internal notification could not be observed (info@ inbox not accessible to A2B), so 'no internal notification' rests on the absence of any opportunity or sheet row plus Codex's workflow configuration. Real Meta receipt of events was not checked (browser Google and Meta requests were stubbed).

recorded_facts.statement: Kitchen, Cornwall Yes (run T1112C, accepted cookies) PASSED on Production. Reached the Kitchen v2 path: the A2B contact was updated (name A2B Kitchen Test, tags meta lead, offer 1: kitchen + £1k upgrade, survey funnel; NO dq tag; no low-priority tag, as the answer was 'Before Christmas'), opportunity 'A2B Kitchen Test' created in Marketing Pipeline stage New Lead (mxSWwRYGpiBQq22XApWD), Leads Master row added (row 74, Offer 1: Kitchen £1000 Appliance Upgrade), and Harry's automated SMS was DELIVERED (includes 'Reply STOP to unsubscribe'). The browser pushed exactly one wren_survey_lead (event id 0d1a1100-4556-4e76-a732-66f83cb9d440).
recorded_facts.provenance: Live test 12 Nov 2026 09:40 UTC through go.wren-builders.online, one submission, read back via the GHL and Sheets APIs.
recorded_facts.limits: The contact already existed (A2B, created 8 Oct, no phone, no tags), so it was updated, not created, and its createdBy does not show the workflow id: routing is evidenced by the Kitchen-specific opportunity, SMS, sheet row and fields. The internal notification email to Wren could not be observed. Kitchen low-priority handling was not exercised.

recorded_facts.statement: Garage, Cornwall Yes (run T1112D, cookies rejected) PARTIAL. Reached the Garage v2 path: the same A2B contact was updated (name A2B Garage Test, tag offer 2: garage conversion + free ac upgrade added, garage answers stored, NO dq tag), a Leads Master row was added (row 75, Offer 2: Garage Conversion New AC) and Harry's Garage SMS was DELIVERED. NO new opportunity was created: the contact already had the open Kitchen test opportunity and the total stayed at 54. Browser: zero third-party requests, no Lead, no token (cookies rejected).
recorded_facts.provenance: Live test 12 Nov 2026 09:41 UTC, one submission, read back twice a few minutes apart.
recorded_facts.limits: Almost certainly an artefact of sharing one contact between both tests (the Phase 2 test contact also holds both offer tags and a single opportunity), but unproven. A fresh destination, or Codex's confirmation of the workflow's duplicate-opportunity rule, is needed. Observation: the Garage SMS had no 'Reply STOP' footer, the Kitchen SMS (first message in the conversation) did; the footer is probably added only to the first message, which a fresh contact would show.

recorded_facts.statement: Meta Lead receipt is NOT verified. The Pixel (1135200792433711) shows last_fired_time 11 Nov 15:49 UTC and zero Lead events, before and after the Kitchen test. The test browser loaded fbevents.js but no beacon to facebook.com/tr was observed, although the sandbox can reach that endpoint, so the automated headless browser most likely suppressed the Pixel.
recorded_facts.provenance: Meta Ads API dataset stats and details checked before and at three points after the test, 12 Nov 2026.
recorded_facts.limits: A person must repeat one qualified-style check in a normal browser (Accept cookies) and look in Events Manager, ideally Test Events. Exactly-one-Lead is unproven. The client side pushed exactly one wren_survey_lead.

Still to sign off and attest as true on launch day: Garage 'limited to 3 homeowners' and 'only taking on 3 garage conversions this month'; 'reserved' on both thank-you pages; 'Book this month to secure your upgrade' honoured for people who book that month; 'reach out within a few hours'; 'fixed quote with no hidden costs'; 'Free home visit'; 'We'll call you from 01872 613608'; kitchen 'Before Christmas'; the review labels and the 'Cornwall homeowners' heading; '100% would come back'; and the provisional copy as a whole. Also read the live ad text in Ads Manager and confirm no ad still carries an expired date (the API could not show it). Exact text: docs/SURVEY-RELEASE-APPROVAL.md section 4.
items.confirmed_by: Harry (Wren Builders), approval relayed by A2B

items.title: Set a fixed retention period and a deletion routine (recommended)
items.detail: Criteria are enough to publish. A number and a routine (for example a GHL workflow that deletes DQ contacts after a set time) would be stronger. No such automation exists today.
